notes: v6.8.0 — AUTO Mode Enhancement Sprint. (1) History persistence fix: removed destructive cleanup save that was overwriting localStorage with empty arrays during React StrictMode double-invocation. Added empty-state guard (don't persist []) and 30s sync interval as safety net. (2) ENGINE-specific color themes: AutoCreativePanel and AutoProgressBar now use distinct colors per engine — Muse AI = blue/cyan, Suno AI = green/emerald, Melo AI = amber/orange. (3) HistoryPanel rewrite: proper rendering for creation_draft/creation_attempt types with status badges, engine-specific icons, and 3 copy buttons per item ('复制概念' for full structured content, '命令' for prompts, '歌词' for lyrics). (4) AUTO song count limit: default 5 songs per AUTO cycle with user-configurable value in Settings page (slider 1-20, per-engine overrides available). (5) Settings page AUTO configuration section: song count slider, countdown slider (10-120s), auto-chain toggle, stop-on-error toggle, per-engine overrides with reset button. (6) Global AUTO chain verified: Dashboard → Muse → Suno → Melo all chain correctly with independent countdowns and progress indicators.
changes: v6.8.0: History persistence fix (no longer lost on browser close) + engine-specific color themes (Muse=blue, Suno=green, Melo=amber) + HistoryPanel with 3 copy buttons per item + configurable AUTO song count (default 5) + Settings page AUTO configuration section + cross-tab sync + sync interval safety net
